name: Search for People (Net-New Prospecting)
description: Search Apollo's database of 270M+ people by title, seniority, location, employer domain, technologies, and more. Returns demographic data without emails/phones (use enrichment flows to get contact details).

personTitles.description: Job titles to search for (matches similar titles by default). Examples: ['sales development representative', 'marketing manager']

personSeniorities.description: Seniority levels. Allowed: owner, founder, c_suite, partner, vp, head, director, manager, senior, entry, intern

personLocations.description: Where people live (cities, states, countries). Examples: ['california', 'ireland']

employeeRanges.description: Employer headcount ranges as 'min,max' strings. Examples: ['1,10', '250,500']

technologies.description: Technologies used by employer (any match). Use underscores for spaces. Examples: ['salesforce', 'google_analytics']
